# digitaltwin.guide

> A public guide to digital twins. Tools for seeing how a farm, a town, a watershed or a region behaves, and what would change if you did something differently. What you can use today, what it costs, and how others have done it.

Every entry is one small markdown file. /index.json lists them all; /graph.json lists the typed links between them; /pack/<question>.md gathers everything one link from a question.

## about

- [Who this is for, and what it is trying to do](/m/about/audience-and-goals.md): The intended audience and the goals behind the guide, stated so that anyone can check the guide against them.

## catalogue

- [Deltares Delft3D](/m/catalogue/deltares-delft3d.md): Models coastal, estuarine and river systems, including water flow and related processes.
- [DHI](/m/catalogue/dhi.md): Combines water-system modeling with operational data, including wastewater treatment twins.
- [Earth Genome / Earth Index](/m/catalogue/earth-genome-earth-index.md): Finds environmental features in satellite imagery through examples, search and review.
- [En-ROADS](/m/catalogue/en-roads.md): Explores combinations of climate policies and their modeled effects.
- [Geodesignhub](/m/catalogue/geodesignhub.md): Organizes spatial proposals, alternatives and stakeholder negotiation.
- [Helsinki / Bologna](/m/catalogue/helsinki-bologna.md): Helsinki publishes city-model data and an energy atlas; Bologna is developing civic twin infrastructure.
- [InVEST](/m/catalogue/invest.md): Maps and values ecosystem services in terrestrial, freshwater, coastal and urban settings.
- [Xylem Vue](/m/catalogue/xylem-vue.md): Combines utility data and water-system modeling for network operations.

## concepts

- [What is a digital twin?](/m/concepts/digital-twin.md): A computational representation of a real object, place or system, linked to information about its real-world counterpart.

## data

- [Copernicus Data Space](/m/data/copernicus-data-space.md): Satellite observations and Earth-observation processing.
- [USGS Water Data](/m/data/usgs-water-data.md): Stream, groundwater and other water observations.

## flows

- [So you want to make a digital twin?](/m/flows/so-you-want-a-digital-twin.md): Five questions. Most people get off before the last one.

## questions

- [Public discussion and learning](/m/questions/combining-proposals.md): What changes when we combine different climate policies or land-use proposals?
- [Flooding, rivers and water services](/m/questions/flooding.md): Which areas will flood, and how will changes to rivers, drainage or pumps affect them?
- [Ecosystems and land management](/m/questions/land-use-change.md): How might land-use changes affect water, habitat, carbon or agricultural production?

## stories

- [A flooded substation](/m/stories/a-flooded-substation.md): Water reaches one substation; water pumping and communications can go down with it.
- [A frog chorus](/m/stories/a-frog-chorus.md): Aircraft noise changes how Pedregal frogs call and thins out their chorus.
- [A late bus](/m/stories/a-late-bus.md): A live model of the roads spots a bus falling behind and helps staff change the signals ahead of it.
